This PKGBUILD follows standard AUR packaging practices for a prebuilt binary package. The sources download the binary tarball and LICENSE file from the package's own GitHub releases (https://github.com/raine/workmux-bin), which is the expected upstream source. All three source entries (LICENSE, x86_64 tarball, aarch64 tarball) have corresponding sha256sums specified, and none are set to 'SKIP'. The build() function generates shell completions by running the application's own binary (`./$_pkgname completions`), which is normal packaging behavior. The package() function installs the binary and completion scripts to standard system directories. There are no eval, curl|bash, base64-encoded blobs, or other suspicious commands. Network requests are limited to the package's own upstream repository, and all file operations are routine install commands. No evidence of malicious code injection, data exfiltration, or backdoors was found.
